name: autovacuum_vacuum_scale_factor
description: Fraction of a table's size (reltuples) that, when added to autovacuum_vacuum_threshold, determines the number of tuple updates or deletes required to trigger an autovacuum VACUUM.
symptoms: Query performance degradation due to outdated statistics
Increased disk usage from dead tuples
tuning_tips: Lower this value (e.g., 0.05–0.1) for large, frequently updated tables to trigger vacuum sooner and prevent bloat; raise it (e.g., 0.3–0.5) for mostly read-only or small tables to reduce vacuum frequency.
